thread:
sophia_sales: Urgent  NimbusX demo in 20m. They're hitting a sudden burst of 429s and a few 502s when they run a scripted spike (~300rps). Can ops/eng jump in to triage?

ryan_oncall: looking now. which route and model? any request ids?

sophia_sales: route: /v1/chat (hosted). model: redwood-micro. sample req id: rx_1c9d4. logs:
```
WARN 429 RateLimitExceeded req=rx_1c9d4 pool=hosted-front reason=burst
ERROR 502 UpstreamError req=rx_1c9d4 upstream=api-gateway timeout=15s
```

lee_runtime: 502s likely gateway backlog; 429 means per-account burst bucket exhausted. Are they using aggressive client retries?

anya_se: they admitted to a parallel load generator. suspect retry storms collapsing the burst bucket. Recommend immediate soft-throttle and advise client-side linear backoff.

olivia_security: also, customer asked about "data residency for ephemeral logs" in the security questionnaire. Can someone confirm retention/region policy for hosted trials?

ryan_oncall: applied temp throttle: account=nimbusx max_burst=50 at 11:12 UTC. monitoring.

lee_runtime: infra shows front proxy queue depth spike at 11:10:34, worker pool saturated. After throttle backlog cleared; a couple 502s persisted due to upstream timeouts.

anya_se: sent the customer a minimal backoff snippet:
```js
// client suggestion
if (resp.status === 429) await sleep(1000 + Math.random()*500);
```

sophia_sales: customer agreed to reduce generator to 150rps for demo. They also asked if we can guarantee EU-only processing for logs/data.

olivia_security: hosted trials are region-routed for inference, but observability may be processed centrally for now. I'll escalate to legal. For immediate response, tell them inference runs in EU region and PII is redacted by default.

lee_runtime: longer-term fix: increase per-account burst bucket and add adaptive warmup to absorb scripted spikes. I'll open ENG ticket to prototype a warmup token.

deploy-bot: throttle configuration updated for account=nimbusx by ryan_oncall at 11:12:02 UTC

anya_se: created PREM-498 for client retry guidance, assigned to solutions-eng.

lee_runtime: ENG-7402 opened to evaluate proxy tuning and adaptive warmup. ETA: 3 days for proposal. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7402

sophia_sales: thanks all. I'll follow up with the customer on pricing for bursts and the security answer. Please post here if anything changes. :pray:

ryan_oncall: monitoring green after throttle; 429s dropped from ~5% to <0.1% and 502s stopped. will watch for 30m.
